name: Comet Pinball
description: An original neon space pinball table that plays itself. Real ball physics with gravity, flippers, pop bumpers, slingshots, drop targets, an orbit lane and a plunger launch each ball. The AI flips at the right moment but not always, so balls are sometimes lost. Three balls per game, multiball when the drop targets are cleared, and an automatic restart after game over. Code-drawn, entirely offline.
author: seeWallpaper
